attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Loyalty program cost attribution: earn and redemption transactions generate costs (points liability, redemption fulfillment) allocated to loyalty program cost centers. Consumer goods finance teams req

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Required for accounting loyalty point expense; loyalty_transaction must post expense to a GL account for financial statements.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.journal_entry. Business justification: Loyalty points liability accounting: under IFRS 15/ASC 606, loyalty points are deferred revenue requiring journal entries at earn and redemption. Consumer goods auditors and finance teams require dire

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the loyalty program account against which this points movement is recorded. Links the transaction to the member's running balance and tier status.

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating sales order or DTC purchase that triggered an earn or redemption event. Null for non-purchase-triggered transactions such as birthday bonuses, referral awards, or manual adjustments.

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.retail_store. Business justification: Loyalty earn and redemption events occur at specific retail stores. Store-level loyalty analytics — which stores drive highest earn rates, redemption patterns by store — is a core CPG retail execution

attributes.name: reversal_reference_loyalty_transaction_id
attributes.description: For reversal-type transactions, the loyalty_transaction_id of the original transaction being reversed. Enables bidirectional audit trail linking between original and reversal entries for points reconciliation.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the end consumer or shopper who owns the loyalty account. Supports GDPR/CCPA data subject requests and consumer-level analytics across the CRM platform.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) purchased or redeemed in this transaction. Populated for purchase-triggered earn events and product-reward redemptions. Enables product-level loyalty attribution and NPD performance analysis.

attributes.name: adjustment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative entered by a customer service agent or system process explaining the rationale for a manual points adjustment or reversal. Supports audit review and consumer dispute resolution.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the business reason for manual point adjustments or reversals (e.g., GOODWILL, DATA_CORRECTION, FRAUD_REVERSAL, SYSTEM_ERROR, PROMOTION_CORRECTION). Populated only for adjust and reversal transaction types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: GOODWILL|DATA_CORRECTION|FRAUD_REVERSAL|SYSTEM_ERROR|PROMOTION_CORRECTION|COMPLAINT_RESOLUTION — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: bonus_multiplier
attributes.description: The multiplier applied to the base earn rate for bonus transactions (e.g., 2.0 for double points, 1.5 for 50% bonus). Null for non-bonus transactions. Used to decompose total points awarded into base and bonus components for TPM ROI analysis.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The consumer engagement channel through which the triggering event occurred: ecommerce (third-party online), mobile_app (brand app), retail_store (physical POS), dtc_website (Direct-to-Consumer website), call_centre (agent-assisted), or kiosk (in-store self-service). Supports omnichannel loyalty analytics and channel attribution reporting.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: The loyalty transaction code of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: consent_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer's active consent for loyalty program participation and data processing was verified at the time of this transaction. Supports GDPR Article 7 and CCPA consent audit requirements.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the market in which this loyalty transaction occurred (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Supports multi-market loyalty program reporting, regulatory compliance (GDPR for EU markets), and geographic performance analytics.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty transaction record was first created in the source system. Serves as the system audit creation timestamp for data lineage, reconciliation, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the monetary_value field (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency loyalty programs operating across international markets.

attributes.name: data_retention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction record is subject to a data retention hold, preventing deletion or anonymization beyond the standard retention period. Set to True for records under legal hold, active fraud investigation, or regulatory audit. Supports GDPR right-to-erasure compliance.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The loyalty transaction description of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: earn_rate
attributes.description: The points-per-currency-unit rate applied to calculate the points_amount for earn transactions (e.g., 1.5 points per USD spent). Captures the rate in effect at the time of the transaction for historical accuracy and program performance analysis.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The effective from of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The effective until of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiry date of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: fraud_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction has been flagged by the fraud detection system as potentially fraudulent or suspicious. Flagged transactions are held for review before points are posted. Supports loyalty program integrity and financial controls.

attributes.name: fraud_review_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the fraud review process for transactions flagged by the fraud detection system: not_reviewed (default), under_review (investigation in progress), cleared (confirmed legitimate), or confirmed_fraud (fraudulent transaction confirmed and reversed).

attributes.name: is_bonus_transaction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this earn transaction includes a bonus points multiplier applied on top of the base earn rate (e.g., double-points promotion, birthday bonus, new member bonus). Enables separation of base earn from promotional bonus in program cost analysis.

attributes.name: loyalty_transaction_status
attributes.description: The loyalty transaction status of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: monetary_value
attributes.description: The monetary equivalent value of the points moved in this transaction, expressed in the program's base currency. Used for points liability valuation on the balance sheet and for calculating the cost of loyalty rewards in COGS reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The loyalty transaction name of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The notes of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: points_amount
attributes.description: The absolute number of loyalty points moved in this transaction. Always stored as a positive value regardless of direction; the transaction_type field determines whether points are added or subtracted from the account balance. Supports fractional points for precision in tiered earn-rate calculations.

attributes.name: points_balance_after
attributes.description: Snapshot of the loyalty account's total available points balance immediately after this transaction was applied. Together with points_balance_before, provides the complete before/after audit trail for each points movement event.

attributes.name: points_balance_before
attributes.description: Snapshot of the loyalty account's total available points balance immediately before this transaction was applied. Critical for audit trail completeness and points liability reconciliation required by finance.

attributes.name: points_direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the points_amount increases (credit) or decreases (debit) the loyalty account balance. Enables double-entry-style reconciliation of the points ledger for finance liability reporting.

attributes.name: points_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the points awarded in this earn transaction are scheduled to expire per the loyalty program's currency expiration policy. Null for non-earn transactions. Drives the points liability aging schedule reported to finance.

attributes.name: points_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this transaction contributes to the outstanding points liability on the company's balance sheet (True for unspent earned points, False for redeemed or expired points). Supports finance's points liability reserve calculation under GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: processing_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the loyalty transaction was processed and posted to the account balance by the loyalty engine. May differ from transaction_timestamp due to batch processing windows or pending verification holds.

attributes.name: program_year
attributes.description: The fiscal or calendar year of the loyalty program in which this transaction occurred. Used for annual points balance resets, year-over-year program performance reporting, and points expiration policy enforcement.

attributes.name: qualifying_spend_amount
attributes.description: The net purchase amount (after discounts, excluding taxes) on the triggering order that qualified for points earning. Used to verify earn rate calculations and supports COGS and loyalty cost-per-transaction reporting.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The record source system of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: redemption_value
attributes.description: The monetary discount or reward value applied to the consumer's order when points are redeemed. Populated only for redeem-type transactions. Used to calculate the effective discount rate and redemption liability release in financial reporting.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The source system code of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: source_transaction_ref
attributes.description: The native transaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Salesforce record ID, SAP document number, POS receipt number). Enables cross-system reconciliation and traceability back to the system of record.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: The transaction date of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable business identifier for the loyalty transaction, formatted as LT-{YYYY}-{sequence}. Used in consumer-facing communications, call-centre lookups, and points dispute resolution.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the loyalty transaction reflecting its processing lifecycle: pending (awaiting confirmation), processed (successfully posted to account), reversed (cancelled after posting), failed (processing error), or cancelled (voided before posting).

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the loyalty points movement event occurred in the real world — i.e., when the triggering business event (purchase, referral, etc.) was confirmed and points were posted. This is the principal business event timestamp, distinct from system audit timestamps.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Categorical discriminator identifying the nature of the points movement: earn (points awarded), redeem (points consumed), adjust (manual correction), expire (points lapsed per program rules), transfer (inter-account movement), or reversal (cancellation of a prior transaction). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: earn|redeem|adjust|expire|transfer|reversal — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: trigger_event
attributes.description: The specific business event that initiated this points movement, such as purchase, referral, product_review, birthday_bonus, promotion_bonus, account_registration, social_share, or survey_completion. Drives attribution analysis and program ROI reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase|referral|product_review|birthday_bonus|promotion_bonus|account_registration|social_share|survey_completion — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: The uom of the loyalty transaction record

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this loyalty transaction record was last modified in the source system. Tracks reversals, status changes, and manual adjustments for audit and data quality monitoring.

products.name: segment
products.description: Consumer segmentation classification and membership records used for targeting, personalization, and marketing activation. Stores segment definition (name, code, model version, type — behavioral/demographic/psychographic/RFM/CLTV-based, description, effective date range, owning brand/BU) and individual membership assignments (shopper reference, assignment date, expiry date, assignment method — rule-based/ML/manual, confidence score, segment version). Enables time-variant segment membership tracking, CRM-driven personalization, and trade promotion targeting across CPG brands.
products.reference: Consumer Segment / CRM Segment (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud)

attributes.name: segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consumer segment definition record in the Consumer Goods lakehouse silver layer. Serves as the primary key for all segment definition and membership records.

attributes.name: consumer_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.consumer_segment. Business justification: Operational consumer segments (loyalty/DTC targeting) must reconcile with marketing-defined consumer segments for campaign planning alignment. This cross-domain segment mapping is a data governance an

attributes.name: parent_segment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the parent segment when this segment is a sub-segment or child in a hierarchical segmentation structure (e.g., 'High-Value Loyalists' as a child of 'Loyalty Program Members'). Null for top-level segments.

attributes.name: activation_channel
attributes.description: The primary marketing activation channel for which this segment is designed (e.g., email campaigns, SMS, push notifications, paid media audiences, in-store promotions). Drives channel-specific audience export configurations in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud and CRM platforms.

attributes.name: age_range_max
attributes.description: For demographic segments, the maximum consumer age (in years) defining the upper bound for segment inclusion. Used alongside age_range_min to define age-banded demographic segments (e.g., Millennials: 28–43).

attributes.name: age_range_min
attributes.description: For demographic segments, the minimum consumer age (in years) required for segment inclusion. Used in age-gated product targeting (e.g., health supplements, alcohol-adjacent personal care) and regulatory compliance with COPPA for under-13 restrictions.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the segment record

attributes.name: assignment_method
attributes.description: Method by which consumers are assigned to this segment. 'rule_based' uses deterministic business rules (e.g., purchase frequency thresholds); 'ml_model' uses a trained machine learning classifier; 'manual' indicates analyst-driven assignment; 'hybrid' combines rule-based and ML approaches.

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: The distribution or engagement channel(s) for which this segment is applicable. 'dtc' (Direct to Consumer) segments target consumers via owned digital channels; 'retail' targets in-store shoppers; 'ecommerce' targets online platform shoppers; 'omnichannel' applies across all channels.

attributes.name: cltv_max_value
attributes.description: For CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)-based segments, the maximum predicted CLTV value defining the upper bound of this segment tier. Used to create banded CLTV segments (e.g., mid-value tier: CLTV between $500 and $2000). Null if no upper bound applies.

attributes.name: cltv_min_value
attributes.description: For CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)-based segments, the minimum predicted CLTV score or monetary value required for a consumer to qualify for segment membership. Enables tiered loyalty and high-value consumer targeting strategies. Null for non-CLTV segment types.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the segment, used in CRM campaign targeting, trade promotion management (TPM) systems, and Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud audience configurations. Unique per segment version.

attributes.name: consent_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under GDPR Article 6 or CCPA for processing consumer data within this segment. 'consent' requires explicit opt-in; 'legitimate_interest' applies where the business has a justified interest; 'contract' applies for contractual necessity; 'not_required' for non-personal aggregate segments.

attributes.name: consent_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit consumer consent is required before a consumer can be assigned to or activated within this segment. True for segments used in direct marketing, personalization, or profiling activities subject to GDPR Article 6 or CCPA opt-in requirements.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: The created date of the segment record

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment definition record was first created in the Consumer Goods lakehouse silver layer. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: criteria_definition
attributes.description: The criteria definition of the segment record

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to monetary thresholds defined in this segment (e.g., rfm_monetary_min, cltv_min_value). Ensures consistent monetary comparisons across geographies and DTC channels.

attributes.name: definition_logic
attributes.description: The definition logic of the segment record

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the segment's defining characteristics, inclusion criteria, and intended business use (e.g., targeting strategy, personalization approach, or trade promotion eligibility). Authored by the owning brand or business unit.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this segment definition expires and is no longer eligible for active targeting. Null indicates an open-ended segment with no planned expiry. Used for time-variant segment membership tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The effective from of the segment record

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this segment definition becomes valid and eligible for use in CRM targeting, personalization, and trade promotion activation. Supports time-variant segment tracking and bi-temporal data modeling in the silver layer.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The effective until of the segment record

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code(s) or region identifiers defining the geographic boundary of this segment (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'DEU'). Supports multi-country CPG brand activation and ensures GDPR/CCPA-compliant targeting within applicable jurisdictions.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: The is active of the segment record

attributes.name: is_suppression_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment is a suppression list used to exclude consumers from campaigns (e.g., opted-out consumers, recent purchasers, regulatory exclusions). True means consumers in this segment are excluded from targeted marketing activations.

attributes.name: last_refresh_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the segment membership was last recalculated and updated. Used to assess data freshness for CRM targeting and to trigger refresh workflows when the segment is stale relative to its defined refresh frequency.

attributes.name: loyalty_tier_scope
attributes.description: The loyalty program tier(s) targeted by this segment. Enables differentiated engagement strategies for loyalty program members (e.g., exclusive offers for Platinum tier, win-back campaigns for Bronze tier). 'all' indicates the segment applies across all loyalty tiers.

attributes.name: min_confidence_score
attributes.description: The minimum ML model confidence score (0.0000 to 1.0000) required for a consumer to be assigned to this segment when using ML-based assignment. Consumers with scores below this threshold are excluded. Null for rule-based or manual segments.

attributes.name: ml_model_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the machine learning model used to generate or score this segment, when assignment_method is 'ml_model' or 'hybrid'. Enables traceability to the model registry for audit, retraining, and explainability purposes. Null for rule_based or manual segments.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the segmentation model or rule set that produced this segment definition (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3'). Enables traceability of segment membership changes across model iterations and supports A/B testing of segmentation approaches.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Human-readable business name of the consumer segment (e.g., 'High-Value Loyalists', 'Lapsed Shoppers', 'Health-Conscious Millennials'). Used in marketing activation, CRM dashboards, and trade promotion targeting.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The notes of the segment record

attributes.name: nps_score_max
attributes.description: For NPS (Net Promoter Score)-based segments, the maximum NPS score (0–10 scale) defining the upper bound for segment inclusion. Used in conjunction with nps_score_min to define NPS-banded segments (e.g., detractors: 0–6).

attributes.name: nps_score_min
attributes.description: For NPS (Net Promoter Score)-based segments, the minimum NPS score (0–10 scale) required for segment inclusion. Enables targeting of promoters (9–10), passives (7–8), or detractors (0–6) for tailored consumer engagement programs.

attributes.name: owning_business_unit
attributes.description: The business unit (BU) within Consumer Goods responsible for this segment's definition, governance, and activation (e.g., 'Personal Care', 'Home Care', 'Health & Wellness'). Used for segment ownership reporting and cross-BU deduplication governance.

attributes.name: personalization_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether consumers in this segment are eligible for personalized content, product recommendations, or pricing in DTC (Direct to Consumer) and e-commerce channels. Requires valid consent_basis when consent_required is True.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank used to resolve conflicts when a consumer qualifies for multiple overlapping segments. Lower values indicate higher priority. Used by CRM and personalization engines to determine which segment's rules take precedence for offer assignment.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the segment record

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The record source system of the segment record

attributes.name: refresh_frequency
attributes.description: How frequently the segment membership is recalculated and updated. Determines the cadence at which consumer assignments are re-evaluated against the segment's rules or ML model. Impacts CRM campaign freshness and personalization accuracy.

attributes.name: rfm_frequency_min
attributes.description: For RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary)-based segments, the minimum number of purchase transactions required within the recency window for a consumer to qualify for the frequency criterion. Null for non-RFM segment types.

attributes.name: rfm_monetary_min
attributes.description: For RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary)-based segments, the minimum cumulative spend amount (in the segment's currency) required within the recency window for a consumer to qualify for the monetary criterion. Null for non-RFM segment types.

attributes.name: rfm_recency_days
attributes.description: For RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary)-based segments, the number of days used to define the recency window (e.g., last 90 days). Consumers with a purchase within this window qualify for the recency criterion. Null for non-RFM segment types.

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the segment definition. 'active' segments are available for CRM targeting and trade promotion activation; 'draft' segments are under construction; 'archived' segments are retained for historical analysis but no longer used in campaigns.

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segmentation methodology applied to define this segment. Behavioral segments are based on purchase patterns; demographic on age/gender/income; psychographic on lifestyle/values; RFM (Recency, Frequency, Monetary) on transactional scoring; CLTV (Customer Lifetime Value)-based on predicted long-term value; geographic on location.

attributes.name: source_segment_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this segment in the originating operational system (e.g., Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud segment ID, Nielsen IQ panel group code). Enables cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing back to the system of record.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The source system code of the segment record

attributes.name: target_audience_size
attributes.description: The estimated or actual count of unique consumers assigned to this segment at the time of last refresh. Used for campaign planning, media budget allocation, and share of voice (SOV) estimation. Not a real-time count — reflects the last segment refresh cycle.

attributes.name: trade_promotion_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consumer segment is eligible for trade promotion targeting within the Trade Promotion Management (TPM) system. True enables the segment to be used in TPM/TPO campaign audience configurations in Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud.

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: The uom of the segment record

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this segment definition record was most recently modified. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail compliance in the Databricks lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Integer version number of this segment definition record, incremented each time the segment's criteria, model, or metadata is materially updated. Supports bi-temporal tracking and enables comparison of segment membership across definition versions.

products.name: consent_record
products.description: Formal consent and privacy preference record for a consumer capturing GDPR, CCPA, and other regulatory consent obligations, including full audit history of all consent changes. Stores consent type (marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, cookies), current consent status (granted, withdrawn, pending), consent version, capture method (web form, app, in-store, call center), capture timestamp, IP address, regulatory jurisdiction, expiry date, and immutable event log of every status change (prior status, new status, change trigger, channel, processing agent/system). This is the SSOT for consumer privacy compliance and provides the complete consent history required for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each consent record in the Consumer Goods consumer privacy system. Primary key for the consent_record data product, serving as the SSOT for GDPR Article 7 and CCPA compliance audits.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the marketing or re-consent campaign that prompted this consent record creation or update. Enables campaign-level consent conversion tracking and supports Trade Promotion Management (TPM) and consumer engagement analytics.

attributes.name: marketing_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Consumer Goods brand for which this consent was captured. Enables brand-level consent reporting and ensures that consent granted for one brand is not incorrectly applied to another brand within the same corporate portfolio.

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer profile record for whom this consent record applies. Links the consent record to the consumer master in the CRM/DTC system (Salesforce Consumer Goods Cloud).

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the consent record record

attributes.name: capture_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer's consent was captured. Identifies whether consent was obtained via a web form, mobile app, in-store interaction, call center agent, paper form, or email link. Required for GDPR proof-of-consent obligations.

attributes.name: capture_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time (with timezone offset) when the consumer's consent action was recorded in the system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent record and is immutable once set. Required for GDPR Article 7 audit trail.

attributes.name: change_trigger
attributes.description: The business reason or event that triggered the most recent change to the consent status. Distinguishes consumer-initiated changes from system-driven expirations, administrative overrides, legal requests (e.g., right to erasure), or re-consent campaigns.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel of the consent record record

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: The consent record code of the consent record record

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The consent date of the consent record record

attributes.name: consent_given
attributes.description: The consent given of the consent record record

attributes.name: consent_language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the consent notice was presented to the consumer (e.g., 'en', 'fr', 'de', 'es-MX'). Required to confirm consent was given in an intelligible form per GDPR Article 7.

attributes.name: consent_proof_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the stored proof-of-consent artifact (e.g., screenshot, signed form scan, call recording reference, Veeva Vault document ID). Supports GDPR Article 7(1) obligation to demonstrate that consent was given.

attributes.name: consent_record_status
attributes.description: The consent record status of the consent record record

attributes.name: consent_scope
attributes.description: Defines the breadth of the consent grant — whether it applies globally across all Consumer Goods brands and products, is restricted to a specific brand, product category, or a single campaign. Enables granular consent management across the product portfolio.

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the consent record indicating whether the consumer has actively granted, withdrawn, or is pending confirmation of consent, or whether the consent has expired past its validity period.

attributes.name: consent_text_snapshot
attributes.description: Verbatim text or reference hash of the consent notice, privacy policy excerpt, or opt-in language presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Immutable record of what the consumer agreed to, required for GDPR Article 7 proof-of-consent.

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The consent timestamp of the consent record record

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Category of consent being captured, defining the specific processing activity for which the consumer has provided or withheld consent. Covers marketing email, SMS, push notification, data sharing, profiling, and cookies as required by GDPR and CCPA.

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice, privacy policy, or terms document presented to the consumer at the time of consent capture. Enables tracking of which policy version was in effect when consent was given, critical for GDPR Article 7 compliance.

attributes.name: cookie_consent_categories
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of cookie categories for which the consumer has granted consent (e.g., 'functional,analytics,marketing'). Captures granular cookie preferences as required by the ePrivacy Directive and GDPR for digital channels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: necessary|functional|analytics|marketing|social_media|personalization|advertising — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the consumer's country of residence at the time of consent capture. Determines applicable privacy regulation (e.g., GDPR for EU countries, CCPA for USA/California). Critical for multi-jurisdiction compliance management.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this consent record was first created in the Consumer Goods data platform (Silver Layer). Distinct from capture_timestamp which records the business event time. Supports data lineage and audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The currency code of the consent record record

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The consent record description of the consent record record

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer when providing consent in digital channels. Supports forensic audit trails and UX analysis of consent capture flows.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer completed a double opt-in confirmation process (e.g., clicked a confirmation link in a verification email) in addition to the initial consent action. Double opt-in provides stronger proof of consent for marketing communications under GDPR.

attributes.name: double_opt_in_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer completed the double opt-in confirmation step. Null if double opt-in was not required or not yet completed. Provides the definitive timestamp for consent activation in double opt-in workflows.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this consent record is considered active and binding. Typically aligns with the capture date but may differ for backdated or scheduled consent activations. Supports MASTER_AGREEMENT role effective-period tracking.

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The effective until of the consent record record

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this consent record expires and must be renewed or re-confirmed by the consumer. Null indicates open-ended consent with no defined expiry. Used to trigger consent renewal workflows and ensure ongoing compliance with GDPR's requirement for time-limited consent.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the consumer submitted their consent. Captured for digital consent channels (web form, mobile app, email link) as evidence of consent origin. May be considered PII under GDPR in some EU jurisdictions.

attributes.name: is_current_record
attributes.description: Indicates whether this row represents the current active consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Supports Slowly Changing Dimension (SCD Type 2) pattern in the Silver Layer, where historical consent versions are retained for audit purposes and this flag identifies the latest version.

attributes.name: legal_basis
attributes.description: The lawful basis under GDPR Article 6 or equivalent regulation for processing the consumer's personal data. Consent is one of six legal bases; this field distinguishes consent-based processing from other lawful bases to support compliance reporting.

attributes.name: minor_age_threshold
attributes.description: Age threshold (in years) used to determine whether parental consent was required for this consent record, based on the applicable jurisdiction's rules (e.g., 16 for GDPR default, 13 for COPPA, 13-16 for EU member state variations). Null if consumer is not a minor.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The consent record name of the consent record record

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The notes of the consent record record

attributes.name: parental_consent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether parental or guardian consent was obtained for a minor consumer. Required under GDPR Article 8 for children under 16 (or lower age threshold set by member state) and COPPA for US consumers under 13.

attributes.name: prior_consent_status
attributes.description: The consent status immediately before the most recent status change. Enables point-in-time audit reconstruction and supports the immutable event log requirement for GDPR Article 7 compliance audits without requiring a separate history table join.

attributes.name: processing_agent
attributes.description: Identifier of the system, application, or human agent (call center representative ID or system name) that processed and recorded the consent event. Supports accountability requirements under GDPR Article 5(2) and provides an audit trail of who or what captured the consent.

attributes.name: profiling_consent_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profiling and Automated Decision-Making Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has consented to automated profiling and decision-making activities, including personalization algorithms, NPS scoring, CLTV modeling, and segmentation. Required under GDPR Article 22 for automated decision-making with significant effects.

tag_set.value: Profiling and Automated Decision-Making Consent Flag

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the consent record record

attributes.name: re_consent_deadline
attributes.description: Date by which the consumer must re-confirm their consent before the current consent record is automatically withdrawn or expired. Null if re-consent is not required. Used to drive automated consent renewal campaigns.

attributes.name: re_consent_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this consent record requires re-confirmation from the consumer due to a material change in the privacy policy, consent notice, or processing purpose. Triggers re-consent outreach workflows in the CRM system.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The record source system of the consent record record

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this consent record for the consumer-consent_type combination. Increments with each status change or update, enabling full audit history reconstruction. Version 1 is the initial consent capture; subsequent versions reflect changes.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The applicable privacy regulation or jurisdiction framework under which this consent record was created and must be managed. Determines the legal basis, retention rules, and consumer rights applicable to this record (e.g., GDPR for EU consumers, CCPA for California residents).

attributes.name: retention_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days this consent record must be retained for compliance purposes after the consent is withdrawn or expires. Determined by applicable regulatory requirements (e.g., GDPR Article 5(1)(e) storage limitation, CCPA). Drives automated data lifecycle management.

attributes.name: source_channel
attributes.description: The source channel of the consent record record

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The source system code of the consent record record

attributes.name: third_party_sharing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consumer has explicitly consented to their personal data being shared with third-party partners (e.g., retail partners, data brokers, analytics providers). Distinct from general data sharing consent; specifically governs external data transfers.

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: The uom of the consent record record

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this consent record in the data platform. Used for incremental data processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer.

attributes.name: withdrawal_method
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. Required to demonstrate that withdrawal was as easy as giving consent per GDPR Article 7(3).

attributes.name: withdrawal_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact date and time when the consumer withdrew their consent. Null if consent has not been withdrawn. GDPR Article 7(3) requires that withdrawal be as easy as giving consent; this timestamp documents the withdrawal event for audit purposes.

products.name: dtc_order
products.description: Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) order with line-item detail placed by a shopper through owned e-commerce or brand website channels. Captures order header (order number, date, status, channel, shipping/billing address, payment method, subtotal, discount, shipping cost, tax, total, currency, fulfillment reference) and line items (SKU/GTIN, product name, quantity ordered/shipped, unit price, line discount, line total, promotion code, fulfillment status, return flag). This is the SSOT for DTC channel order transactions and enables SKU-level purchase analysis, replenishment triggers, and product affinity modeling.
products.reference: DTC Order / SAP SD Sales Order

attributes.name: dtc_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) order record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_HEADER.

attributes.name: ar_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ar_invoice. Business justification: DTC order-to-cash cycle: each DTC order generates an AR invoice for collections, dispute management, and revenue recognition under IFRS 15/ASC 606. Consumer goods DTC finance teams require this link f

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Order‑to‑Campaign linkage enables ROI analysis by attributing direct‑to‑consumer orders to the marketing campaign that generated the purchase.

attributes.name: company_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.company_code. Business justification: Multi-entity DTC operations: consumer goods companies operating across legal entities require each DTC order attributed to a company code for statutory financial reporting, VAT/tax compliance, and int

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Order processing costs are allocated to internal cost centers for budgeting and variance analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_facility. Business justification: Order fulfillment report requires order-level DC assignment for shipping cost, OTIF metrics, and inventory allocation.

attributes.name: distribution_shipment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_shipment. Business justification: DTC last-mile delivery tracking: links a consumer DTC order to its distribution shipment for delivery performance reporting, customer shipment notifications, and carrier OTIF compliance. Distinct from

attributes.name: fulfillment_network_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.network_node. Business justification: DTC orders are fulfilled from a specific supply network node (DC/fulfillment center). Supply network allocation reporting and node-level capacity planning require knowing which network node fulfilled

attributes.name: fulfillment_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to procurement.supplier. Business justification: Drop-ship DTC fulfillment requires tracking which supplier fulfilled each order for supplier OTIF performance reporting, cost allocation, and compliance audits. A consumer goods domain expert expects

attributes.name: loyalty_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to consumer.loyalty_account. Business justification: A DTC order earns and redeems loyalty points (loyalty_points_earned, loyalty_points_redeemed columns exist on dtc_order). Linking dtc_order directly to loyalty_account enables direct reconciliation of

attributes.name: order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.order. Business justification: Required for consolidated revenue reporting across channels; DTC orders must be reconciled with central sales order for finance.

attributes.name: outbound_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.outbound_order. Business justification: DTC order fulfillment process: each consumer DTC order generates a distribution outbound_order for warehouse execution. Operations and customer service teams track which outbound_order fulfills which

attributes.name: price_list_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.price_list. Business justification: DTC orders in CPG are priced against a specific consumer price list (DTC channel price list, promotional price list, loyalty tier price list). This FK enables DTC pricing audit, margin analysis by pri

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: DTC channel P&L reporting: consumer goods companies track DTC as a distinct profit center. Each DTC order must be attributed to a profit center for channel-level revenue and margin reporting, a standa

attributes.name: retail_store_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.retail_store. Business justification: Omnichannel CPG DTC orders are frequently initiated in-store (endless aisle, ship-from-store, click-and-collect). Linking DTC orders to the originating retail store enables omnichannel attribution rep

attributes.name: shipping_address_id
attributes.description: The shipping address id of the dtc order record

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer (shopper) who placed this DTC order. Links to the consumer master profile in the Consumer domain SSOT, enabling CLTV analysis, loyalty program attribution, and personalization. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER PARTY_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer subscription plan that generated this DTC order, when subscription_order_flag is True. Links to the subscription master for recurring order management, churn analysis, and subscription revenue reporting.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: The date the shipment was confirmed as delivered to the consumer. Compared against promised_delivery_date to calculate OTIF performance and identify late delivery patterns for carrier SLA management.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the dtc order record

attributes.name: billing_address_same_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Billing Address Same as Shipping Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the billing address is identical to the shipping address for this order. When False, a separate billing address record is maintained. Used for payment processing and fraud risk scoring.

tag_set.value: Billing Address Same as Shipping Flag

attributes.name: carrier_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the shipping carrier assigned to deliver this DTC order (e.g., UPS, FedEx, USPS, DHL). Used for carrier performance analysis, SLA tracking, and logistics cost allocation.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel of the dtc order record

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: The specific owned DTC channel through which the order was placed (e.g., brand website, mobile app, social commerce). Enables channel-level performance analysis, attribution modeling, and Share of Voice (SOV) reporting across DTC touchpoints.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: The dtc order code of the dtc order record

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DTC order record was first ingested and created in the Silver layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and ETL reconciliation. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this order (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Required for multi-currency financial consolidation, FX reporting, and EBITDA calculations. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The dtc order description of the dtc order record

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used by the consumer to place this DTC order. Used for UX optimization, mobile commerce analytics, and channel attribution modeling to improve conversion rates across device types.

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied at the order header level, including promotional codes, loyalty redemptions, and trade promotion discounts. Used for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) ROI analysis and net revenue reporting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment.

attributes.name: dtc_order_status
attributes.description: The dtc order status of the dtc order record

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The effective from of the dtc order record

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The effective until of the dtc order record

attributes.name: fulfillment_ref
attributes.description: External reference number linking this DTC order to the fulfillment system (e.g., Blue Yonder WMS warehouse order, 3PL fulfillment reference, or SAP WM transfer order). Enables end-to-end order-to-delivery traceability and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment state of the DTC order at the header level, indicating whether all line items have been picked, packed, and shipped. Used for OTIF (On Time In Full) KPI reporting and supply chain performance dashboards.

attributes.name: gift_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DTC order was placed as a gift, triggering gift wrapping, suppression of price information on packing slips, and gift message inclusion. Used for seasonal demand analysis and consumer gifting behavior modeling.

attributes.name: ip_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from the consumer's IP address at the time of order placement. Used for fraud detection, geo-restriction compliance, and cross-border commerce analytics. Classified as potentially PII under GDPR.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the consumer for this DTC order, based on the order total and applicable loyalty tier multipliers. Feeds into CLTV calculations and loyalty program engagement analytics.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the consumer as a discount on this DTC order. Used for loyalty liability accounting, redemption rate analysis, and consumer engagement reporting.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The dtc order name of the dtc order record

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The notes of the dtc order record

attributes.name: order_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: DTC Order Placement Date and Time
attributes.description: The exact date and time (UTC) when the consumer submitted the order through the DTC e-commerce or brand website channel. This is the principal business event timestamp used for demand planning, daily sales reporting, and S&OP inputs. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category.

tag_set.value: DTC Order Placement Date and Time

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the DTC order, tracking progression from placement through fulfillment or cancellation. Used for order management dashboards, OTIF reporting, and consumer communication triggers. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER LIFECYCLE_STATUS category. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|processing|shipped|delivered|cancelled|returned — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_timestamp
attributes.description: The order timestamp of the dtc order record

attributes.name: order_total_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount charged to the consumer, calculated as subtotal minus discounts plus shipping plus tax. This is the authoritative revenue figure for DTC channel financial reporting and EBITDA contribution analysis. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET net total.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument type used by the consumer to complete this DTC order (e.g., credit card, PayPal, digital wallet). Used for payment analytics, fraud detection, and consumer payment preference reporting. Note: No raw card data is stored; only the instrument type.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current status of the payment transaction associated with this DTC order, tracking authorization through capture or refund. Critical for revenue recognition, accounts receivable (DSO), and consumer dispute resolution.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_ref
attributes.description: External payment gateway transaction reference or authorization code for this order. Used for payment reconciliation, chargeback management, and financial audit trails. Does not contain sensitive card data (PCI DSS compliant tokenized reference only).

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: The delivery date committed to the consumer at the time of order placement, based on Available to Promise (ATP) or Capable to Promise (CTP) logic. Used for SLA compliance measurement and consumer expectation management.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or coupon code entered by the consumer at checkout, linking this order to a specific Trade Promotion Management (TPM) campaign. Enables TPM ROI measurement, promotional lift analysis, and Trade Promotion Optimization (TPO) modeling.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the dtc order record

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The record source system of the dtc order record

attributes.name: return_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any item in this DTC order has been returned or a return has been initiated. Used for return rate analysis, product quality monitoring, and consumer satisfaction (NPS) correlation studies.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the order return (e.g., defective product, wrong item, consumer changed mind). Populated when return_flag is True. Used for quality defect analysis, product improvement, and COGS impact reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: defective|wrong_item|not_as_described|changed_mind|damaged_in_transit|late_delivery|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ship_to_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the shipping destination of this DTC order. Used for carrier routing, last-mile delivery, and geographic sales analysis. Classified as PII under GDPR and CCPA.

attributes.name: ship_to_city
attributes.description: City of the shipping destination for this DTC order. Used for geographic demand analysis, Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP), and regional marketing segmentation.

attributes.name: ship_to_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the shipping destination. Drives international shipping compliance, customs documentation, import/export regulatory requirements, and multi-country revenue reporting.

attributes.name: ship_to_name
attributes.description: Full name of the recipient at the shipping address for this DTC order. May differ from the ordering consumer (e.g., gift orders). Required for carrier label generation and last-mile delivery. Classified as PII under GDPR and CCPA.

attributes.name: ship_to_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the shipping destination. Used for carrier rate calculation, geographic clustering, and micro-market demand analysis.

attributes.name: ship_to_state_province
attributes.description: State or province of the shipping destination. Used for tax jurisdiction determination, regional sales reporting, and regulatory compliance (e.g., state-level FDA or EPA requirements).

attributes.name: shipped_date
attributes.description: The date the order was physically dispatched from the fulfillment center or warehouse. Used for lead time analysis, carrier handoff tracking, and revenue recognition timing under ASC 606.

attributes.name: shipping_amount
attributes.description: Shipping and handling charges billed to the consumer for this DTC order. Used for logistics cost analysis, free-shipping threshold reporting, and net revenue calculations.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The source system code of the dtc order record

attributes.name: source_system_order_ref
attributes.description: The native order identifier from the originating e-commerce platform or ERP system (e.g., Salesforce Commerce Cloud order ID, SAP SD sales order number). Used for cross-system reconciliation, EDI integration, and data lineage tracing back to the system of record.

attributes.name: subscription_order_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this DTC order was generated as part of a recurring subscription (subscribe-and-save) program. Used to distinguish subscription revenue from one-time purchase revenue for CLTV modeling and replenishment trigger analysis.

attributes.name: subtotal_amount
attributes.description: The gross merchandise value of all line items before discounts, shipping charges, and taxes are applied. Used as the base for promotional discount calculations, COGS analysis, and gross margin reporting. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total sales tax or VAT charged on this DTC order, calculated based on the shipping destination jurisdiction. Required for financial reporting, tax compliance, and SOX audit trails. Part of TRANSACTION_HEADER MONETARY_TRIPLET adjustment.

attributes.name: total_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of the dtc order record

attributes.name: tracking_number
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned tracking number for the shipment associated with this DTC order. Provided to the consumer for last-mile visibility and used internally for delivery confirmation and OTIF measurement.

attributes.name: uom
attributes.description: The uom of the dtc order record

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this DTC order record in the Silver layer, capturing status changes, address corrections, or payment updates. Supports change data capture and audit compliance. Satisfies TRANSACTION_HEADER RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category.

products.name: dtc_order_line
products.description: Individual line item within a DTC order representing a single SKU purchased. Stores order reference, SKU/GTIN, product name, quantity ordered, quantity shipped, unit price, line discount, line total, promotion code applied, fulfillment status, and return flag. Enables SKU-level purchase analysis, replenishment triggers, and product affinity modeling for CPG DTC channels.
products.reference: Sales Order Line Item / SAP SD Order Item

attributes.name: dtc_order_line_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual line item within a DTC order. Primary key for this entity. Role: TRANSACTION_LINE.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to marketing.campaign. Business justification: Line‑level attribution assigns each ordered SKU to the campaign that promoted it, supporting product‑level campaign performance reporting.

attributes.name: demand_plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.demand_plan. Business justification: DTC order line actuals are reconciled against demand plan buckets to measure forecast accuracy (MAPE/bias). Demand planners attribute actual DTC sales to specific plan versions for variance analysis.

attributes.name: distribution_facility_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fulfillment warehouse or distribution center from which this order line was or will be shipped. Supports Distribution Requirements Planning (DRP) and warehouse performance analytics.

attributes.name: dtc_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent DTC order header. Establishes the header/detail relationship for this line item. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE HEADER_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue recognition at line level: DTC order lines post to specific GL accounts by product category (e.g., food vs. personal care revenue accounts). Consumer goods finance requires line-level GL attri

attributes.name: price_list_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to sales.price_list_item. Business justification: Each DTC order line is priced against a specific price list item (SKU-level price). This FK supports DTC line-level pricing audit, promotional price validation, margin-per-SKU reporting, and price com

attributes.name: shopper_id
attributes.description: Reference to the end consumer or shopper who placed the DTC order. Enables consumer-level purchase history, CLTV analysis, and personalization. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE PARTY_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: sku_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product SKU purchased on this line. Enables SKU-level purchase analysis, product affinity modeling, and replenishment triggers. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE RESOURCE_REFERENCE category.

attributes.name: subscription_id
attributes.description: Reference to the consumer subscription record that triggered this order line, when subscription_flag is True. Enables subscription lifecycle analysis and recurring revenue reporting.

attributes.name: actual_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was confirmed as delivered to the consumer. Used for OTIF calculation, consumer satisfaction analysis, and carrier performance reporting.

attributes.name: actual_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was physically dispatched from the fulfillment warehouse. Used to calculate On Time In Full (OTIF) performance and carrier SLA adherence.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The amount of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the brand under which the product on this order line is marketed. Supports brand-level revenue reporting, Share of Market (SOM) analysis, and brand portfolio performance tracking.

attributes.name: channel_code
attributes.description: Identifies the specific DTC sub-channel through which this order line was placed (e.g., brand website, mobile app, subscription program, social commerce). Supports channel-level revenue attribution and consumer journey analytics.

attributes.name: code
attributes.description: The dtc order line code of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: cost_of_goods_sold
attributes.description: Standard cost of goods for the units on this order line at time of sale. Used for gross margin calculation, DTC channel profitability analysis, and EBITDA reporting. Classified confidential as it reveals internal cost structure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this order line record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides audit trail for data lineage and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this order line are denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency DTC operations and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: The dtc order line description of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: dtc_order_line_status
attributes.description: The dtc order line status of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The effective from of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The effective until of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: fulfillment_status
attributes.description: Current fulfillment lifecycle state of this order line. Tracks progression from order confirmation through warehouse picking, packing, shipment, and delivery. Supports On Time In Full (OTIF) monitoring and consumer communication. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|confirmed|picking|packed|shipped|delivered|cancelled|backordered — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: gift_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line was designated as a gift by the consumer. True when the consumer selected gift options (e.g., gift wrapping, gift message). Supports gifting program analytics and packaging operations.

attributes.name: gtin
attributes.description: GS1-standard Global Trade Item Number for the product on this line. Enables cross-retailer product identification, barcode scanning, and regulatory traceability. Conforms to GS1 GTIN-8, GTIN-12 (UPC), GTIN-13 (EAN), or GTIN-14 formats.

attributes.name: hazmat_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the product on this order line is classified as a hazardous material requiring special handling, packaging, or shipping restrictions. True for products subject to DOT, IATA, or EPA hazmat regulations. Critical for carrier compliance and Safety Data Sheet (SDS) requirements.

attributes.name: is_returned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line has been subject to a consumer return. True when a return has been initiated or completed. Enables return rate analysis by SKU, category, and consumer segment for product quality and consumer experience programs.

attributes.name: line_discount_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary discount applied to this order line, including promotional discounts, coupon redemptions, and loyalty rewards. Used for Trade Promotion Management (TPM) analysis and margin reporting.

attributes.name: line_discount_pct
attributes.description: Discount rate applied to this order line expressed as a percentage of the gross unit price. Enables promotional effectiveness analysis and margin impact assessment without requiring price recalculation.

attributes.name: line_net_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of this order line after all discounts have been applied but before tax. Core revenue recognition field for DTC channel P&L reporting and COGS analysis. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_VALUE_OR_RESULT monetary component.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this line item within the parent DTC order. Used for ordering, display, and reconciliation of multi-line orders. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_SEQUENCE category.

attributes.name: line_subtotal
attributes.description: Gross line value before tax, calculated as unit_price multiplied by quantity_ordered. Represents the pre-discount, pre-tax revenue contribution of this line item.

attributes.name: line_total
attributes.description: The line total of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: line_total_amount
attributes.description: Final total amount for this order line inclusive of all discounts and taxes. Represents the actual amount charged to the consumer for this line item. Used for revenue reporting and consumer billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_earned
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points earned by the consumer for purchasing this order line. Supports loyalty program accrual tracking, Consumer Lifetime Value (CLTV) modeling, and consumer engagement analytics.

attributes.name: loyalty_points_redeemed
attributes.description: Number of loyalty program points redeemed by the consumer as a discount on this order line. Enables loyalty redemption rate analysis and program liability management.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: The dtc order line name of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: The notes of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: product_category_code
attributes.description: Hierarchical product category classification code for the SKU on this line (e.g., Personal Care > Hair Care > Shampoo). Enables category-level sales analysis, assortment planning, and consumer purchase pattern segmentation.

attributes.name: product_name
attributes.description: Commercial name of the product SKU as displayed to the consumer at time of purchase. Captured at order time to preserve historical accuracy independent of future product name changes.

attributes.name: promised_delivery_date
attributes.description: Date communicated to the consumer as the expected delivery date for this order line. Drives consumer expectation management, NPS impact analysis, and carrier performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: promised_ship_date
attributes.description: Date on which the order line was committed to ship to the consumer at time of order placement. Basis for Available to Promise (ATP) and Service Level Agreement (SLA) compliance measurement.

attributes.name: promotion_code
attributes.description: Promotional or coupon code applied by the consumer at checkout that triggered a discount on this order line. Enables Trade Promotion Management (TPM) redemption tracking, campaign ROI analysis, and fraud detection.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: quantity_cancelled
attributes.description: Number of units cancelled on this order line, either by the consumer or due to inventory unavailability. Supports cancellation rate analysis and demand signal correction.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Number of units of the SKU ordered by the consumer on this line. Basis for demand planning, inventory reservation, and fulfillment processing. Satisfies TRANSACTION_LINE LINE_QUANTITY category.

attributes.name: quantity_shipped
attributes.description: Actual number of units of the SKU dispatched to the consumer for this line. May differ from quantity_ordered due to partial fulfillment, Out of Stock (OOS) situations, or split shipments. Key metric for On Time In Full (OTIF) measurement.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: The record source system of the dtc order line record

attributes.name: regulatory_hold_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this order line is subject to a regulatory hold preventing fulfillment (e.g., FDA product recall, CPSC safety alert, EU REACH restriction). True when a hold is active. Supports compliance-driven order management and consumer safety programs.

attributes.name: return_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for the consumer return of this order line. products.name: segment_membership
products.description: This association product represents the Segment Membership between a shopper and a consumer segment. It captures the operational record of a specific shopper being assigned to a specific segment within a CPG CRM or CDP system, including the method of assignment, ML confidence score, effective date range, and exit reason. Each record links one shopper to one segment and carries attributes that exist only in the context of this individual membership — they cannot reside on the shopper record (which is identity-level) or the segment record (which is definition-level). Supports time-variant membership tracking, personalization activation, and campaign targeting across CPG brands.. Existence Justification: In CPG consumer data platforms, a single shopper is actively assigned to multiple segments simultaneously (e.g., a 'High-Value RFM' segment AND a 'Millennial Demographic' segment AND a 'Lapsed Buyer' behavioral segment), and each segment contains thousands of shoppers. This is not an analytical correlation — CRM and CDP systems actively create, update, and expire individual membership records as part of campaign targeting and personalization workflows. The relationship is a recognized operational entity called 'segment membership' with its own lifecycle data (assignment method, confidence score, effective dates, exit reason) that cannot reside on either the shopper or segment record alone.

Values: rule_based (deterministic criteria), ml_model (probabilistic scoring), manual (human override), imported (external system feed). Belongs to the membership, not the segment definition or the shopper identity.

In the correct model, CLTV segment membership is represented as a segment_membership record linking the shopper to the appropriate CLTV-type segment. The label on shopper is redundant and creates a maintenance inconsistency — it should be removed in favor of querying the membership association.]

attributes.description: Net amount for this invoice line before taxes and charges. Typically calculated as invoiced_quantity multiplied by unit_price, adjusted for any line-level discounts.

attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the invoice. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the invoice document.

attributes.name: line_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to this invoice line. Calculated based on the tax code and net amount.

attributes.name: line_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to this invoice line. May include supplier remarks or internal annotations.

attributes.name: match_status
attributes.description: Three-way match status for this invoice line. Indicates whether the line matches the PO and GR within acceptable tolerance thresholds.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp

attributes.name: name

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.description: Difference between invoiced quantity and goods receipt quantity. Positive values indicate over-invoicing; negative values indicate under-invoicing.

attributes.name: sustainability_certification

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Withholding tax code for this invoice line. Applicable in jurisdictions requiring tax withholding at source for certain supplier payments.

products.name: profit_center
products.description: Master record for profit centers representing autonomous business segments within the consumer goods enterprise — product lines, brands, or geographic business units. Tracks revenue, cost, and profitability at a granular level below the legal entity. Integrates with SAP S/4HANA CO-PCA (Profit Center Accounting) and Oracle Cloud Financials for segment reporting and EBITDA decomposition.

attributes.name: company_code_id

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_id

attributes.name: address_line_1

attributes.name: amount

attributes.name: country_code

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: description

attributes.name: fax_number

attributes.name: functional_area_code

attributes.name: geographic_region_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country or region code representing the primary geographic location of the profit center for regional segment reporting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level

attributes.name: hierarchy_node

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the profit center is locked for transaction postings. Used during period-end close and audit processes.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Full business name of the profit center representing the product line, brand, or geographic business unit.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: phone_number

attributes.name: planning_enabled_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this profit center participates in budgeting and financial planning processes.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the profit center's location. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: product_category_code

attributes.name: profit_center_status

attributes.name: profit_center_type
attributes.description: Classification of the profit center by organizational dimension: product line, brand, geographic region, sales channel, or business unit. Determines the segment reporting structure.

attributes.name: quantity

attributes.name: responsible_person_email

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: valid_from_date

attributes.name: valid_to_date
